spec: Write semver.py implementing Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 precedence. `parse(v: str) -> tuple` validates strictly (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, no leading zeros in numeric parts, optional -prerelease of dot-separated identifiers where numeric identifiers have no leading zeros, optional +build metadata) and raises ValueError otherwise. `compare(a: str, b: str) -> int` returns -1/0/1 per SemVer rules (build metadata ignored; a pre-release is lower than the release; numeric identifiers compare numerically and are lower than alphanumeric ones; a shorter pre-release list is lower when all preceding identifiers are equal). `bump(v: str, part: str) -> str` for part in major/minor/patch drops pre-release and build and resets lower parts. Standard library only.
